simulation_level: host protocol state-machine and synthetic response model
bfl_nonce_model: SHA256(SHA256(midstate_bytes || tail_bytes || nonce_big_endian)); accepts first hash byte zero
bfl_nonce_model_limit: The code hashes the serialized midstate as message bytes. It does not restore that midstate as SHA-256 compression state. Its one-byte target is synthetic. Do not use these nonces as Bitcoin/ASIC correctness vectors.
icarus_nonce_model: Exact golden work returns the predefined golden nonce. Other work returns the first four SHA256(work) bytes.
icarus_nonce_model_limit: Deterministic protocol fixture only; not an ASIC nonce search.

thermal_model.model_limit: Poll-driven temperature updates; no calibrated wall-clock thermal dynamics.

error_injection: Optional random response corruption; reproducibility requires control of the random state.
